label: Insert row
intent: A new row is inserted into the table. Light: the plus pushes toward the rows, the row in the middle slot is shoved down one slot and the bottom row drops out and fades, then a new row slides out of the plus into the open slot, overshoots a little and settles. Strong: the plus pulls back first, then shoves harder; the displaced row overshoots farther and settles, and the new row shoots in from farther with a bigger overshoot and a settle. The top row never moves.

shifted.//: hidden at rest: a copy of the middle row that takes its place (same pixels) and is pushed down one slot, where it hands back to row-3

new-row.//: hidden at rest: the inserted row; it slides out of the plus into the middle slot and hands back to row-2

motion.//: Rows are 8.5 apart. The rows below part first, then the new row slides into the open slot. Every hand-off happens with both copies on the same pixels; the bottom row only drops 2 so it stays 1.4 inside the canvas.
